(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirit. Or, if you have three cards or less in Hand, you can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a "Lampo" among them to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If you have five counters or more, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.

BS63-026.name: The WindWingedSerpent Ehecatl
BS63-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can discard three cards from your decktop. Then, if [Soul Core] is in your Counter Area, you can summon/deploy a "Grandwalker Kukulkan", or a Cost 7 "Dark Snake" family Spirit card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your Cost 7 "Dark Snake" family Spirits can't be blocked.

BS63-064.name: The Witch Rene-Bernoulli
BS63-064.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any “The PartnerCat Fermat”, when you're summoning/deploying/using a “Golden Cloud” family card, you can also use symbols of cards in your Trash to reduce the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any “The PartnerCat Fermat”, the cost of every Spirit card in the opposing Hand/Removed Zone is changed to 6.

BS63-016.name: Thread Sword Paradise
BS63-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 10000 BP. For each counter you have, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +1000.

[LV2][LV3]
All your "Lava Fish" family Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

BS63-CX01.name: The PartnerBurai Vrick
BS63-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2]
You can add a card with [Load]/[Fast Draw] discarded by your [Fast Draw] to your Hand. Also, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Mirage effects.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] [Load: 2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Your counters +2. Then, you can put up to two cards from your decktop facedown under your "The PartnerBurai Vrick", including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition. (The cards beneath are discarded when that card/Spirit has left the Field.)

BS63-CX02.name: The PartnerCat Fermat
BS63-CX02.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2]
(Can't Stack) When your other Cost 3 or more "Golden Cloud" family Spirit is summoned, you can draw a card from the deckbottom.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, if you've summoned for three times or more during this turn, you can return an opposing LV2 Spirit to the deckbottom.
